Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Josh Hart?

Josh Hart is 31 years old.

Where was Josh Hart born?

Josh Hart was born in Silver Spring, Maryland.

When was Josh Hart born?

Josh Hart was born on March 6, 1995.

How tall is Josh Hart?

Josh Hart is 6-5 (196 cm) tall.

How much does Josh Hart weigh?

Josh Hart weighs 215 lbs (97 kg).

Is Josh Hart in the Hall of Fame?

Josh Hart is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Josh Hart drafted?

Josh Hart was drafted by Utah Jazz, 1st round (30th pick, 30th overall), 2017 NBA Draft.

What position does Josh Hart play?

Small Forward and Shooting Guard.

What is Josh Hart's net worth?

Josh Hart has made at least $84,011,239 playing professional basketball.

How much does Josh Hart make?

Josh Hart made $19,472,240 in 2026.

How many rings does Josh Hart have?

Josh Hart has won one championship.

What is Josh Hart's Instagram account?

Josh Hart is on Instagram at jhart.

What schools did Josh Hart attend?

Josh Hart attended Sidwell Friends in Washington, District of Columbia and Villanova.

What are Josh Hart's nicknames?

Josh Barkley, Hart of the City are nicknames for Josh Hart.
